column1: 22590§probe§prəʊb§The space probe sent back useful information to us.§太空**探测器**给我们发回了有用的信息。§
22591§panic§ˈpænɪk§In fact I'm starting to panic as the project deadline is in two weeks and I don't seem to be making any progress at all.§事实上，当距课题研究的最后期限只剩两个星期时我开始**惊慌失措**起来，因为我还是一点进展也没有。§
22592§disturb§dɪˈstɜːb§One of the most concerning elements of acid rain is that it disturbs the natural balance of lakes and rivers.§在酸雨带来的破坏中，最令人担心的是它**破坏**了河流和湖泊的自然平衡。§
22593§grassy§ˈgrɑːsi§To the east of us, you'll see no building at all—just trees and flowers and a huge grassy area.§在我们的东面，你根本看不到建筑物，唯有树木、花卉和大片**绿地**。§
22594§glorious§ˈglɔːriəs§Our country has a glorious past.§我们的祖国有着**辉煌**的历史。§
22595§fertile§ˈfɜːtaɪl§The east of this region is flatter and more low-lying, with fertile soils.§这一地区的东部土壤**肥沃**，地势较为平坦，海拔也比较低。§
22596§amateur§ˈæmətə(r)§Only amateur athletes are allowed to compete in this sports games.§这次运动会只允许**业余**运动员参加。§
22597§undisguised§ˌʌndɪsˈɡaɪzd§They looked upon the creature with a loathing undisguised.§他们看那动物的眼神流露出**明显**的厌恶。§
22598§silver§ˈsɪlvə(r)§A German alchemist tried to transmute silver into gold.§一位德国的炼金术士试图将**白银**炼成黄金。§
22599§fulfillment§fʊlˈfɪlmənt§The company gains its reputation from delivering fast and accurate order fulfillment services.§该公司因其快速而准确地**完成**订单而声名远播。§
22600§aspire§əˈspaɪə(r)§The looks on children who aspired to go to school in some poor areas deeply moved me.§在一些贫困地区，孩子们**渴望**上学的眼神深深地打动了我。§

22601§recession§rɪˈseʃn§During the economic recession, more and more countries begin to take trade protectionist measures, which is a block to the global economic recovery.§经济**衰退**期间，越来越多的国家开始采取贸易保护措施，阻碍了全球经济的复苏。§改例句：可数名词单数 block 前缺冠词，补 a
22602§miscellaneous§ˌmɪsəˈleɪniəs§A little child's pockets are likely to contain a miscellaneous collection of objects.§小孩子的口袋里往往装有**各种各样**的东西。§
22603§utilization§ˌjuːtəlaɪˈzeɪʃn§This research provides the scientific foundation for rational utilization of land.§这项调查为合理**使用**土地提供了科学依据。§

22604§caustic§ˈkɔːstɪk§This paper mainly introduces the test status of filtrating equipment in medicine industry used for diaphragm caustic soda cooling process.§这篇文章主要论述了医药行业用于隔膜**烧**碱冷却工序的过滤装置的试验情况。§改例句：主语 This paper 是第三人称单数，introduce 改为 introduces

22605§detergent§dɪˈtɜːdʒənt§The auto beauty company often uses the professional cleaning detergent foam, and then wipes the car slightly with a clean soft cloth.§汽车美容公司通常会使用专业泡沫**清洁剂**清洁汽车，然后用干净的软布轻轻擦拭。§改例句：主语 company 是第三人称单数，use、wipe 改为 uses、wipes
22606§reclaim§rɪˈkleɪm§As he stopped the payment by installment, the finance company tried to reclaim his house.§在他停止分期付款后，该信贷公司试图**收回**他的房屋。§
22607§deflect§dɪˈflekt§The bullet hit a wall and then deflected from its course.§子弹击中墙壁后**改变了方向**。§

22608§trench§trentʃ§The next stage of the project involves trench excavation, cable laying, construction backfilling and reinstatement, and landscaping works.§该工程的下一阶段包括**坑道**挖掘、电缆铺设、建筑回填和修复以及景观美化工程。§
22609§holistically§həˈlɪstɪkli§In the innovation time, the firm must design its innovation process holistically.§在这个创新的时代，企业必须**全面**设计自己的创新流程。§
22610§urbanization§ˌɜːbənaɪˈzeɪʃn§The intervention of government plays an important role in solving the problems in the process of urbanization.§政府干预对解决**城市化**过程中出现的问题起着重要作用。§
22611§insularity§ˌɪnsjuˈlærəti§Japan is an insularity and such geographical feature forms its distinctive natural landscape.§日本是一个**岛国**，这一地理特征形成了它独特的自然景观。§
22612§permeate§ˈpɜːmieɪt§As a kind of research study, this method is permeated in all the courses as well as all activities of students.§作为一种研究性学习，这种方法**渗透**于学生的所有课程和所有活动中。§
22613§repack§riːˈpæk§He had to repack his case after the customs officers opened it during the security inspection.§在海关人员打开包裹安检后，他必须**重新打包**他的行李。§
22614§disruptive§dɪsˈrʌptɪv§The school accident preliminarily resulted from some disruptive students in the crowd.§这起校园事故的初步原因是一些学生在人群中**制造混乱**。§

22615§clinical§ˈklɪnɪkl§The experiment results show that the proposed evaluation method has good clinical value, which will be further accepted by more medical workers.§实验结果表明，提出的评价方法具有良好的**临床**价值，将进一步被更多医学工作者所接受。§
22616§momentum§məˈmentəm§She worked day and night with the momentum of going abroad for further education.§出国深造是她夜以继日辛勤工作的**动力**。§

22617§disempower§ˌdɪsɪmˈpaʊə§You disempower yourself to do anything about it, because you always think it beyond your ability.§你总是觉得这件事超出了你的能力，所以**剥夺**了自己去做些什么的力量。§改译文：原译「没有给自己力量」是否定式意译，括不出 disempower（使失去权力），改为「剥夺了自己…的力量」
22618§depletion§dɪˈpliːʃn§Many western countries have taken measures to prevent the depletion of their dollar reserves.§许多西方国家已经采取措施，防止**损耗**其美元储备。§
22619§authenticate§ɔːˈθentɪkeɪt§There is no way to authenticate the recording at present, but the voice sounds like Lily's.§目前还没有办法**鉴别**这盘录音带的真伪，但是声音听起来像莉莉。§
22620§anatomy§əˈnætəmi§Leon devoted his life to studying the human anatomy.§利昂毕生致力于研究人体**解剖学**。§
22621§confidence§ˈkɒnfɪdəns§The message is that you have little confidence.§（反馈出的）信息就是你没什么**自信**。§
22622§commencement§kəˈmensmənt§The high school seniors engaged in high jinks after commencement.§**毕业典礼**后，中学毕业生狂欢了一场。§
22623§chemical§ˈkemɪkl§The chemicals will contaminate water resources when drained into the river.§这些**化学物质**如果被排放到河里会污染水源。§
22624§literal§ˈlɪtərəl§The literal meaning of the phrase "say what you like" is "feel free to say anything you want".§这个短语的**字面**意思是“说你想说的，不用拘束”。§改例句：删去句末重复的排版残留「“say what you like”」；中文引号改为英文引号
22625§comprehensive§ˌkɒmprɪˈhensɪv§His account of the meeting was most comprehensive.§他对会议的叙述**面面俱到**。§
22626§glue§gluː§I've prepared this so that I don't get glue everywhere.§我已经有所准备，这样就不会把**胶水**弄得到处都是。§
22627§bureau§ˈbjʊərəʊ§The university's careers bureau is open from nine to five and offers free advice on job applications.§大学的就业指导**办公室**从九点开放到五点，免费为求职申请提供建议。§补例句

22628§observe§əbˈzɜːv§She has observed that if a left-handed person is brain-damaged in the left hemisphere, the recovery of speech is quite often better than that of a right-handed person.§她**观察**到，如果一个左撇子的大脑左半球受损，他的语言恢复能力会比右撇子好很多。§
22629§brood§bruːd§In the brood chamber, the bees will stash honey to eat later.§蜜蜂在**育雏**箱中贮藏蜂蜜，以供日后食用。§改译文：原译「巢箱」括不出 brood（一窝雏），改为「育雏箱」
22630§interdependent§ˌɪntədɪˈpendənt§The society, economy and environment are interacting and interdependent.§社会、经济和环境相互作用，**彼此依赖**。§
22631§murder§ˈmɜːdə(r)§The murder seemed planned.§这场**谋杀**显然是蓄意策划的。§
22632§prominent§ˈprɒmɪnənt§Suzhou is one of the earlier prominent port cities.§苏州是较早的**著名**港口城市之一。§
22633§conventional§kənˈvenʃənl§Most people prefer conventional housing now.§现在很多人偏爱**传统**式的住宅。§
22634§productivity§ˌprɒdʌkˈtɪvəti§This process enhanced our ability to improve productivity and quality.§这一方法增强了我们提高**生产力**和质量的能力。§
22635§viscous§ˈvɪskəs§Numerous tiny worms were floating in a viscous liquid.§**黏稠**的液体里飘浮着无数的小蠕虫。§
22636§transform§trænsˈfɔːm§The new genetical anatomy will transform medicine and reduce human suffering in the twenty-first century.§在21世纪，新的基因解剖学将**彻底改变**药品形式并减轻人类的痛苦。§
22637§strategist§ˈstrætədʒɪst§The Japanese strategist talked about the impact of globalization on nations.§那位日本**战略家**谈到了全球化给各国带来的影响。§
22638§indulge§ɪnˈdʌldʒ§Overseas visitors like to come here to indulge in one of Astoria's more famous agricultural products—wine.§外国游客喜欢到这里**尽情**品尝美酒，这是阿斯托里亚较出名的农产品之一。§
22639§personality§ˌpɜːsəˈnæləti§If you are in a role for long, it eventually becomes part of you, part of your personality.§如果你长久地处于一个角色中，最终它将成为你的一部分，成为你**个性**的一部分。§
22640§definition§ˌdefɪˈnɪʃn§The definition of any individual's role in any situation will be a combination of the role expectations.§任何情况下对任何个人角色的**定义**都会是对角色期待的综合。§
22641§host§həʊst§We will be hosting more than 250 participants for the lectures and workshops.§我们将**接待**250多位参加讲座和讨论会的人员。§
22642§feminism§ˈfemənɪzəm§We discuss everything from personal experience to future society and feminism.§我们从个人阅历、未来社会或**男女平等主义**的角度来讨论每件事。§
22643§abate§əˈbeɪt§After the closedown of the airport, noise pollution abated.§机场关闭后，噪音污染**减轻**了。§
22644§expectation§ˌekspekˈteɪʃn§The company failed to meet shareholders' expectations.§公司没有满足股东的**期望**。§
22645§excessive§ɪkˈsesɪv§Each month, managers would analyse the pattern of absence of staff with excessive sick leave.§每个月，经理们都会分析请**过多**病假的员工的缺勤模式。§
22646§brilliant§ˈbrɪliənt§That's a brilliant solution to the problem.§那可真是一个解决问题的**绝妙**办法。§改译文：原译「好」只是 good，没有译出 brilliant（卓越的），改为「绝妙」
22647§seminar§ˈsemɪnɑː(r)§You should prepare before you attend this seminar.§参加这次**研讨会**之前你应该准备一下。§
22648§navigable§ˈnævɪgəbl§The depth of the navigable channel of this river is 40 feet.§这条河**可航行**河段的水深为40英尺。§
22649§foul§faʊl§The football player was penalized for his foul.§那名足球运动员因为**犯规**而被判罚。§
22650§contemplate§ˈkɒntəmpleɪt§In order to compete in the world market, we contemplate improving our present product.§为了参与国际市场的竞争，我们**打算**改进现有产品。§
22651§budget§ˈbʌdʒɪt§I'm going to talk about ways of making sure that you eat well while at the same time staying within your budget.§我将会谈到一些方法，让你在不超过**预算**的前提下吃好。§
22652§flee§fliː§Citizens were forced to flee the besieged city.§居民们被迫**逃离**这座被围困的城市。§
22653§worthwhile§ˌwɜːθˈwaɪl§I'm sure you've done many worthwhile things in the last ten years.§我确信在过去的十年里，你做了很多**有意义**的事。§
22654§clamp§klæmp§If you do not have a parking sticker, the workers will clamp your car wheel and give you a fine.§如果你没有停车许可证，工作人员会**夹住**你的车轮并对你进行罚款。§
22655§convenience§kənˈviːniəns§The newly-built apartment building provides gas, electricity and other modern conveniences.§这幢新盖的公寓大楼提供煤气、电以及其他一些现代化**便利设施**。§
22656§migrant§ˈmaɪgrənt§The migrants fly to the south before winter.§**候鸟**在冬天来临之前飞往南方。§
22657§specify§ˈspesɪfaɪ§It is not necessary to specify quantity when ordering beer.§预定啤酒时无需**指定**数量。§
22658§deviance§ˈdiːviəns§The investigation of deviance can reveal interesting and significant aspects of "normal" societies.§对**偏常行为**的研究会揭露出“正常”社会中一些有趣且重要的情况。§改例句：中文引号改为英文引号
